title: x509 appendix: RFC 2119 keyword declaration omits REQUIRED/RECOMMENDED
description: Codereview pass 3 (edge, kimi-k3) on project-LICHEN-worker6-al5r surfaced a pre-existing spec-hygiene nit in spec/appendix-x509-cert-profile.md. Line 32 declares 'Key words MUST, MUST NOT, SHOULD, MAY are per RFC 2119' but the document also uses REQUIRED (e.g. line 19 Proof-of-possession heading; line 34 validity) and RECOMMENDED (e.g. line ~172 validity 200 days, line ~205 ecdsa-with-SHA256). REQUIRED and RECOMMENDED are both valid RFC 2119 keywords; the declaration sentence is simply incomplete. Pre-existing (RECOMMENDED predates al5r). Fix: expand the declaration to enumerate all RFC 2119 keywords the document uses (add REQUIRED, RECOMMENDED, and optionally SHOULD NOT/MAY/OPTIONAL per RFC 2119 §1), or adopt the standard 'are to be interpreted as described in BCP 14 (RFC 2119/RFC 8174)' boilerplate. Trivial one-line spec edit.
